server_inputs.drc: float, predicted DRC (%) of the chosen location, supplied by Component 1

coagulation_time.api_units: the API returns coagulation_time_hours (minutes / 60) and shows it as hours and minutes
coagulation_time.water_acid_source: water_acid model output for the same batch

preprocessing: none outside the artifacts, raw values are passed in feature order
missing_values: not allowed, every feature is required
